chunks: Those who deny Our revelations are deaf, dumb, and lost in the dark. God sends whosoever He wills astray, and leads whom He will to the straight path.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual condition of those who deny God's revelations according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the state of the disbelievers in Surah Al-An'am, where their deafness and dumbness are interpreted as a consequence of their willful rejection of truth, leading to a 'seal' upon their hearts. The mention of divine decree (al-mashī'ah) underscores God's authority in both guiding and misguiding, reflecting the balance between divine will and human agency in the path to righteousness.
